name: tunis-traffic
description: Real-time traffic map for Tunis with search, favorite places and a traffic-aware departure planner. Next.js frontend and NestJS + MongoDB API.
author: Hamdi Werhani (https://github.com/hamdiwerhanii)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend start:demo" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter backend start:prod" "pnpm --filter frontend start"
